title: SqlContract
description: DDL + type/choice-column metadata emitted by the Python bridge. Consumed by the dbchart extension host to render SQL previews and drive dialect-aware features.

SqlDialect.description: Dialect identifier. postgres is the default relationalize dialect.

name.description: Logical column name as seen in the source schema.

rawType.description: relationalize raw label: str | int | float | bool | none | datetime | unsupported:<python-type> | c-<dash-delimited choices>.

sqlType.description: Physical SQL column type emitted for this column. Null for logical mixed choice columns - see choiceOf.

choiceOf.description: Present only for choice columns: the physical SQL names mapped to each member type.

sqlType.description: Physical SQL type for this member (e.g. BIGINT).

ddl.description: Full CREATE TABLE statement generated by the dialect.
